svg.text: Track: Track cursor on/off for every open graph (also T). Off by default.
Track cursor Settings: choose the columns of the Track table and its opacity.
Highlight: a dot on every curve where the line crosses it, other curves dimmed.
Pin: on, the line stays and you drag it; off, it follows the mouse.
Track table: X at the line, then every curve's value there, highest first.
